fact: ARTP, the telecoms regulator, launched a public consultation in March 2026 on deploying and sharing FTTx fibre networks and received twenty-one contributions from operators, public developers, equipment makers, consultancies and individuals.
ARTP published on its website a synthesis report of the twenty-one contributions to the FTTx consultation, setting out points of convergence and the range of positions expressed.

The World Bank's GovTech record (2025) lists the Jubbanti platform at jubbanti.sec.gouv.sn as a Senegalese national platform allowing citizens to take part in policy decision-making; the year is the survey round's, the record gives none.
